public_comment.speaker: John Bowen Jr.
public_comment.topic: Memorial Day flag staking event and student government
public_comment.quote: john bowen jr., 162 highland street, addressed the select board regarding the annual memorial day flag staking event, in which flags are placed on veterans' graves in advance of the holiday. mr. bowen noted that in past years the effort had been limited to only three participants; himself, cemetery superintendent todd hohman, and one dpw employee and urged broader community involvement this year. he requested that the town post a flyer on the town website to publicize the event.
